judgment: It is good to hold firm.
It is good to ford the great river.
image: Heaven inside the mountain: Great Store.
So the noble one grows rich in former words and past deeds,
lines: It is good to hold firm in hardship.
It is good to have somewhere to go.
A board on the young bull's horns.

notes.name_en: 大畜 great storing/restraining; paired with 9 Small Store. Not Wilhelm's 'Taming Power of the Great'.
notes.L2: 輿說輻: same wording as 9 L3 in the base text, so the same English, word for word.
notes.L4: 牿 a board bound across a young bull's horns so it cannot gore.
